assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single widescreen 16:9 editorial illustration for a financial news article, suitable for both inline body image and object-cover hero. Primary request: explain visually the coexistence of oil supply pressures and financing of AI computing infrastructure. Subject: in one elegantly composed clearly illustrated scene, generic dark oil storage tanks and a pipeline in the foreground, balanced with glowing server cabinets and a silicon chip in the middle distance. Sophisticated painted and paper-cut editorial style, tactile surfaces, restrained deep navy, slate blue and warm amber. No real place, no people, no company logos, no words, no numbers, no currency symbols, no charts, no financial graphs, no flags, no watermarks. No fire, explosions, combat, or documentary news-photo appearance. This is a symbolic conceptual image, not any actual event, facility or transaction. Keep all important elements in the center-safe 75 percent of the wide canvas. Opaque background. Generate exactly one standalone 16:9 landscape image.
assets.rightsBasis: Original AI-generated editorial illustration requested for this publication; no external photograph or artwork used as a reference. Not a photograph or evidence of an actual event.
